# Vendored Pierre Diffs

This directory contains the `dist` output from `@pierre/diffs` version 1.2.12.

It is kept locally so the diff and conversation UI owns the Pierre implementation it renders with. Runtime dependencies remain declared in the root `package.json`; the upstream Apache-2.0 license is in [LICENSE.md](./LICENSE.md). The local `package.json` preserves Pierre's tree-shaking boundary.
